items: In a large bowl, beat brown sugar and butter until blended. Beat in egg and molasses.
Combine the flour, ginger, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; gradually add to brown sugar mixture and mix well (dough will be stiff).
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 9-11 minutes or until set.
Cool for 1 minute before removing from pans to wire racks.
